_comment: The engine's config inside the container, mounted at /etc/inference/config.json.
Copy to docker/config.json (gitignored) and fill in your Mac.
host.docker.internal is the Mac running Docker Desktop, from inside a container.
For an engine on another machine, use the Mac's hostname for ssh and address,
and set model_bind so the model servers listen on an interface it can reach -
plus a real api_key: the engine then requires it from every client, and MTPLX checks it too.
machine is the Mac's profile: python3 -m inference machine on the Mac prints it.
identity and known_hosts are where the entrypoint copies the files compose
mounts under /etc/inference/ssh - with the 0600 permissions ssh insists on.
